title: Multi-step flow with stepper
description: A step indicator and navigation for flows split into 3-6 stages (checkout, setup, application): shows step names, the current step, completed steps, and lets users go back to completed steps without losing data. Each step validates before advancing; a review step precedes final submission.
intent: Break a long task into understandable stages so users know where they are, what is left, and can correct earlier answers.
characteristics: ordered list of named steps with current and completed states
review step summarizing all answers with edit links
interaction: Continue validates the current step; completed steps are links, future steps are not interactive; each step has its own URL so browser back works; focus moves to the step heading on navigation.
responsive: Full step list collapses to "Step 2 of 4: Delivery" with a disclosure to see all steps on narrow screens.
accessibility: Stepper is an ol inside nav with a label; current step has aria-current="step"; status of each step is in text, not only icons; step heading receives focus after navigation.
limitations: Overkill for fewer than three short steps.
Branching flows need the step list to update, which can confuse if steps appear late.
